definitions.gloss: itching to do something; eager; restless
definitions.explanation: Feeling a strong urge or impatience to do something.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}きたくて→行く：00119_iku⟧うずうず⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧うずうず⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: My body is restless before the match.

examples.japanese: ⟦{言|い}いたい→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あって→ある：00006_aru⟧うずうず⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。

examples.english: My hands are itching to get started.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦たち→達：01551_tachi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遊|あそ}びたくて→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧うずうず⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The children were restless with eagerness to play outside.

notes:
USAGE:
うずうず(と) + verb / うずうずする

Describes an urge to act that the speaker is holding back. There is always something they want to do and are not yet doing — that gap is the whole meaning of the word.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦したくて→する：00392_suru⟧うずうず⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be itching to do ~) — by far the most common frame
- ⟦{待|ま}ちきれなくて→待ちきれる：30367_machikireru⟧うずうず⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be unable to wait)
- ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧うずうず⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (one's hands are itching — eager to get to work, or to fight)
- ⟦{血|ち}→血：01659_chi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧うずうず⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (one's blood is stirring)

NUANCE:
Forward-looking and usually positive: the anticipation is welcome even when the waiting is not. It describes the person's own inner state, so it is used freely of oneself and only inferentially of others.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦むずむず→むずむず：06756_muzumuzu⟧: itching. Covers a literal physical itch as well, and its restlessness is milder and more irritable than eager.
- ⟦そわそわ→そわそわ：05267_sowasowa⟧: fidgety. Restlessness from nerves rather than desire, and it shows on the outside.
- ⟦わくわく→わくわく：05158_wakuwaku⟧: excited. Pure pleasant anticipation, with no urge to act on it — you can わくわく while sitting perfectly still.
